description: Data.SA is a collection of resources listed in the DITRDCSA Data Catalogue under the Regional Data Hub group, published by Department of the Premier and Cabinet, Government of South Australia. Data.SA provides a searchable catalogue of datasets and resources released openly by South Australian Government agencies and local councils, including a wide range of topics and geographic regions within South Australia. Users can search the portal using keywords, refine results using filters, or browse datasets by category. Data.SA is managed by the Department of the Premier and Cabinet. Coverage is the states and territories; spatial detail follows the source and is not stated in the entry. The catalogue lists the update frequency as not stated, the status as current, and the entry was last changed on 2023-08-15. Files and pages listed: HTML (1 resources), reached from the source page and the catalogue entry, with the CKAN API giving the metadata. Access is free of charge and open; the licence is not stated in the catalogue entry (source page not read). Caveats: the record was written from the catalogue metadata only, so the source page was not opened, the file contents were not checked, and many entries are HTML landing pages or PDF reports, not data files. It can support capacity and investment planning studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ditrdcsa-data-catalogue-australia.
